text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki is struggling to quell the
fiery aggression in her. That's
our first
hurdle, so I've been brainstorming
solutions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now, I think I've got a lead.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You want to learn more about Kongo
Yaegaki martial arts?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day I first met her, Yaeno Muteki was
repeating forms to calm her
mind before
the tryouts—just like she said she did as a
child.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have no doubt that the source of her
usual composure lies in Kongo
Yaegaki
teachings, so I'm sure it'll help find a way
to control her
blaze.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Well, I gather this interest in it has
something to do with suppressing
my
blaze.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I see your train of thought. Follow me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Master. Adept. We are ready for the
lecture. We humbly ask your
guidance.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
It's a pleasure to have you, Trainer. We're
flattered to hear that
you've taken an
interest in the Kongo Yaegaki school.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
I believe seeing it in action will explain
more than words. I hope you'll
enjoy
today's lesson.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soon after...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Sei! HAH!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Good, that's the idea. Next, try to punch
without tipping your whole
body's balance
forward. Instead of raising your head up,
let your
body relax and dangle, like a
puppet on a string.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno, let your waist sit lower! The motion
should be sharp. Again!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Understood! Thank you, Master!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While the forms I'm practicing are
admittedly much simpler than
Yaeno
Muteki's, I complete a basic training
session, getting an
overview of the school's
style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...That said, trying all those new moves has
me exhausted. I rest for a
bit, watching
Yaeno Muteki practice.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Trainer, may I have a word?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki continues the lesson with
her grandmother, while her

grandfather—master of the Kongo Yaegaki
school—softly approaches
me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to thank you for looking after
my granddaughter.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
I can guess what brought you here. The
aggressive blaze in her is
affecting her
racing, and she seeks to extinguish it with
the tranquility
of water. Am I correct?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
I thought as much. Her posture is stiff—her
motions, shallow. I sense
fear in her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
She's been scared of the blaze for so long,
she has a tendency to
overcompensate,
trying too hard to be still as water.
However,
Trainer, it's not so simple...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Master both blaze fierce and water still—a guardian you will be.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Kongo Yaegaki is a school that emphasizes
defense, you see. The
saying about fire
and water speaks to the importance of
balancing
aggressive and passive stances.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Hot-headed fighting spirit alone leads to
hasty, sloppy actions,
burning energy that
could have been used to protect.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Likewise, having only the composure of
tranquil water is no better, for

overthinking causes hesitation. By the time
one moves, it may be too
late.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
That is why the concepts of "blaze fierce"
and "water still" are taught
in tandem. A
guardian must act immediately, but
intelligently.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
In Kongo Yaegaki, we use set forms, called
katas, in order to channel
wild, fire-like
power into calculated, fluid motions.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
I hope that makes sense. Extinguishing
Yaeno's fire with tranquility is
not the
answer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: I believe that is true for both martial arts and racing. What she lacks is balance. That is what she must endeavor to master.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
So you'd like to brainstorm ways to
balance blaze fierce and water
still in
racing? Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Well, as you've already heard from my
grandfather, Kongo Yaegaki
uses katas to
channel wild power.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That begs the question—what is the racing
equivalent of a kata?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In martial arts, katas are motions designed
to combat specific
situations. By
repeatedly simulating the optimal
response to
hypothetical attacks, the user
is prepared to face them for real.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, the closest equivalent I
can think of is...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I see! The "blaze fierce" is the
determination to beat opponents.
"Water
still" is the composure to assess the
situation!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And the "katas" that balance them in the
world of racing... They're the
various
strategies we practice to adapt to unique
race conditions!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That means... If I study the strategies, I'll
be able to wield the blaze
with water's
poise!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This is a great revelation. For now, my
path is clear.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I must learn from the wisdom of one
experienced in the field.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
As I understand, the title of "Trainer" is
granted to those with deep
knowledge of
racing.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I ask that you continue to lend me your
guidance.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Please teach me the katas—the many
strategies of Umamusume
racing. I wish to
study them all!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I hear sincerity in your voice...
and it rings true in my
heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It remains to be seen whether strategies
alone will give Yaeno Muteki
the balance
she seeks, but for now, they're definitely
worth
practicing!
